summary:
w178 reviewed: one commit, 641f95a9. It is the same change as the dfc78964 the implementer lists (cherry-picked; scripts/tests/features identical).
r9, r67, r82, r100 and r101 are implemented as planned under reading B: awaiting-asker requests asked by this context are printed with their open questions and turn exit 0 into 3; intake questions are written with ask before the merge, and a failure resets and faults.
The three deprecated scenarios removed are exactly those under Retires; no other test was removed or weakened. Six focused scenarios pass; size check clean.
Two Minor observations: test_supervision.py:36 import order is a new ruff I001; the report's line 'tools check: nothing to check' is inaccurate.
No Critical and no fix-now finding.
